text: False alarm (high confidence): checkout-api p99 latency above 2s

text.text:
:no_bell: *False alarm* · High confidence
Deploy 4f2c1a went out at 14:01. p99 latency rose from 400 ms to 2.6 s about 90 seconds later.

fields.text:
*Why it fired*
A nightly batch job raises p99 for two minutes.

*How to stop it*
Fire only after 5 minutes above 2 s.
Leave out the batch endpoint.

text.text:
*Findings*
• p99 rose at 14:02, 90 s after the deploy. <https://signoz.example.com/d/abc|SigNoz>
• Timeouts to payments-gw in the logs from 14:02. <https://signoz.example.com/l/def?from=1&to=2|Logs>
• _Hypothesis, no evidence yet:_ The gateway itself is fine

*Proposed fixes*
1. Roll back 4f2c1a
2. Cap retries at 2 in the payment client
